scripts.build:diagrams: likec4 export png --filter index --flat --theme light -o /tmp/ctx-light && likec4 export png --filter index --flat --theme dark -o /tmp/ctx-dark && mkdir -p dist/assets && cp "$(find /tmp/ctx-light -name '*.png' | head -1)" dist/assets/context-light.png && cp "$(find /tmp/ctx-dark -name '*.png' | head -1)" dist/assets/context-dark.png
scripts.build: npm run build:app && npm run build:diagrams && cp landing/index.html dist/index.html
